options.reason: No liquid single-stock option market in Japan for this name. JPX option volume is concentrated in the index, so there is no event-implied move and no skew. Until 2026-09-18 that left priced_lean_pct as -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, which is ALSO the free control, so the baseline's lean and its own benchmark were the same number. They are no longer: `positioning` and `expected_move` below carry substitutes built from what Tokyo does publish, and this baseline supplies its own `priced_lean_pct` and `anchor_quality`.

history.caveat: Announcement DATES are estimated by applying this quarter's notified lag backwards to prior period ends; the move is the largest within +/-2 trading days of that estimate. This is a cadence prior, not a record that a print happened on that date. Use it as a scale for how much this name moves, never as evidence about a particular past date.

event_plausibility.basis: issuer-notified date carried by JPX on the 決算発表予定日 sheet

positioning.basis: sum of disclosed positions at or above 0.5% of shares outstanding, aggregated over sellers
positioning.margin_ratio_basis: 信用倍率, margin long balance / margin short balance, scraped from a broker portal rather than published by the exchange. Null is a normal outcome.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of twelve ESTIMATED prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it, and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels.

baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. Read researcher_japan/scripts/jp_priced_in.py, lean_components(): every weight is a PRIOR, none is measured on Japanese data, and jp_resolve.py ranks each component separately so measurement can replace them. What matters today is only that this is no longer identical to -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, so the free control is a real rival again.

anchor_quality.basis: magnitude: realised vol plus an estimated-cadence reaction history, capped at 0.5 because neither is an option-implied move. direction: how many of the three positioning components resolved, capped at 0.60 because none of them is 25-delta skew.

Q2 operating profit grew +29.8% while the H2 plan needs only +19.7%, so Q3 OP is likely ~1,040-1,060m against a plan-implied ~1,000m, and 9-month progress lands around 75% against 70.2% at the same point in 2025.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 OP +93.5% beat, released 2026-04-21 15:30: +0.12% next session, then -3.80%. Q2 2026 beat plus upgrade, 2026-07-22: +2.29% (FISCO: 'upside was expected, reaction limited'). Q3 2025 9-month OP 10.9% below the internal plan, 2025-10-21: -1.95%. Close-to-close from Yahoo daily bars.
evidence.why_not_priced: Bronco Billy publishes no monthly sales. Same-store comps appear only in the quarterly 参考資料, so Jul-Sep demand is unseen until today. Partly offsetting: the stock is already at an all-time high, which suggests a decent quarter is expected. If the beat were fully priced, the stock would not be trading only ~34x the revised EPS while the plan implies H2 growth well below the H1 pace.
evidence.independence: Q2 2026 参考資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260722/140120260721597065.pdf) for H1 comps 107.7% and the H2 plan. JF industry data for August 2026 (https://www.jfnet.or.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/getujidata-2026-8.pdf): family restaurants 103.7%, western-style FR 105.5%, but yakiniku only 101.2% and weak late in the month. That is a proxy and mixed. Caution from the same company document: June 2026 customer count was 92.5% (comps 102.0%).

evidence.text: A forecast revision at Q3 is unlikely: kabutan's revision record shows the company revised only at Q2 in 2023, 2024 and 2026, never at Q3. The stock trades at 2,950, above Tokai Tokyo's raised 2,800 target (2026-08-13) and about 23% above its 2,398 pre-Q2 close. So a beat with the plan held risks a sell-the-news (出尽くし) reaction, as Q1 2026 showed.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026, plan held with a strong beat: +0.12% then -3.80% (FISCO 2026-04-22: 'short-term sense of news being out'). FY2025 print with a flat-ish new guide (OP +1%): -3.16% on 2026-01-21.
evidence.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the run-up and the sector-policy rally are visible to everyone. What is not obviously in the price is that holders who bought the new highs may want a second upgrade the company has never given at Q3. A market that expected a hold would not have bid the stock above the sell-side target into the print.
evidence.independence: Analyst target: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3091&b=n202608131171 (2026-08-13). Reaction to Q1: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3091&b=n202604220881. The sector rally that lifted the stock was policy speculation, not company news: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3091&b=n202610200583.

That implies Q3 (Oct-Dec) ordinary profit of about 68,950m. The company H1 plan is OP 104,900m / ordinary 104,800m (Q1 短信, https://www.disco.co.jp/jp/ir/library/doc/fr/fr20260723.pdf). This is one estimate source and the page does not date its consensus, so the bar is single-sourced and every size is capped small. print_vs_bar compares the H1 ordinary profit implied by the 観測 (~110bn) with 112.4bn.
first_hunter_context.positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 2026-10-21: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5% and no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 11.16: margin longs are crowded, the one setup where a disappointing guide still has sellers. Minkabu retail 'buy forecasts rising' put DISCO 2nd on 10-20 and 5th on 10-21 (kabutan). No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.59, almost all from margin overhang. Tape: run_up_20d +1.26%, but the stock rose from 53,320 to 65,500 into the 10-06 flash and has fallen back to 53,080, which is -19% from the 10-06 close and about -42% from the 91,680 high of 6-23.

evidence.text: IFIS consensus implies Oct-Dec ordinary profit of about 69.0bn: 9M 181.3bn less H1 112.4bn. That is about 13% above the ~61bn Q2 the Nikkei 観測 implies (H1 OP ~110bn less Q1 49.0bn). DISCO's July guide for Jul-Sep (OP 55.9bn) came in below a consensus of 60bn+ and the stock fell about 12%, so another conservative guide below this bar is the likeliest shape of the release.
evidence.source_date: 2026-10-22 (fetched; consensus date not shown on the page)
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: When the one-quarter-ahead guide undershot consensus at the July 2026 print (Jul-Sep OP 55.9bn vs 60bn+), the stock fell about 12% the next session (kabutan/Fisco 2026-07-24; baseline -12.27). When the FY guide came in near consensus at the Jan 2026 print, the stock rose about 17% (kabutan 2026-01-22). The Apr 2026 Q1 guide of +22% YoY drew a flat-to-negative reaction (-3.78). In the baseline, the last two October prints rose: +7.67 in 2024 and +5.03 in 2025.
evidence.why_not_priced: Only the Oct-Dec guide is new at this print. The conservative-guide habit is well known (Fisco called the July guide 'in line with its conservative tendency'), and since 10-06 the stock has fallen 19%, which may already discount a soft guide. If that were fully priced, the IFIS 9M number would have been cut toward ~175bn. On the page it still implies +13% QoQ.
evidence.independence: July reaction article, a different source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202607240555 (guide below 60bn+ consensus, sharp fall). The Q2 base comes from Fisco on the 観測: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610190340

evidence.text: The Jul-Sep quarter is already out. On 10-06 the non-consolidated flash put H1 sales at 213.6bn against a 201.1bn plan (+6.2%) and Q2 shipments at a record 123.9bn (+60% YoY, +6.4% QoQ); the stock fell 6.3% on 10-07. On 10-19 a Nikkei report put H1 OP near 110bn, about 8bn over the 104.9bn plan, and Fisco called it in line. That leaves the consolidated H1 about 2% under IFIS's 112.4bn ordinary-profit consensus.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-released quarters have been sold or ignored: -6.3% on the 10-07 flash, a 'sharp fall' on the 07-07 Q1 flash, 'limited reaction' to the Jan 9 flash, and 'no surprise' on the 07-21 and 10-19 観測 reports (kabutan).
evidence.why_not_priced: It is priced. The flash and the 観測 are public and the stock sold both, so this line is filed at 0.
evidence.independence: Nikkei 観測 via Fisco: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610190340. This shares the quarter with finding 1's Q2 base and only sets that base; it is not counted twice.

evidence.text: On 10-15 TSMC, the largest buyer of DISCO's advanced-packaging grinders and dicers, beat its Q3 guide (US$46.7bn) and guided Q4 to $52.3-54.3bn. It held FY2026 capex at $60-64bn after Q3 capex of about $13.8bn, which arithmetically implies a large Q4 step-up. With DISCO's record Q2 shipments and its shipped-but-not-yet-accepted inventory build (Q1 inventory +11.6bn), this argues for a firm Oct-Dec shipment and sales plan.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean history of DISCO reacting to a customer's capex. On the 2026-10-15 session the Japanese semicap names fell sharply (DISCO -8.5%), so the market did not read the run-up to TSMC's print as positive for DISCO.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is public and DISCO has fallen since. The residual is transmission. The market sees it in DISCO only through DISCO's own shipment plan, which comes out tonight. If it were priced, the stock would not have kept falling after 10-15 while IFIS's Q3 bar stayed +13% QoQ.
evidence.independence: Same period, company level: DISCO's non-consolidated Q2 shipments record (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6146&b=n202610070754). The Q4 capex arithmetic is a secondary computation (https://stockhub.kr/en/news/news_b40c7d7eea3f) that I did not confirm in TSMC's own document.

evidence.text: The interim dividend forecast is 171 yen (+42), set against an H1 net profit plan of 73.8bn. With H1 profit running about 5% over plan on the 観測, the interim dividend will likely be raised modestly with the results, as it was at the October 2025 interim print.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: At FY prints DISCO's dividend increases (+68 yen on the FY2025 year-end, Apr 2026) did not lift the stock (-3.78). Dividend changes are mechanical with profit, and the stock does not react to them separately.
evidence.why_not_priced: Barely unpriced: anyone can compute it from the 観測. Its size reflects that.

evidence.text: SK hynix (HBM, a major DISCO grinder customer) reports Q3 2026 on 2026-10-27/28. The Hana estimate is OP +29% QoQ. This is after the window.

evidence.text: The Feb-2027 DPU forecast of ¥2,450 was set in April without Toyosu Prime Square: ¥29.4bn, appraisal NOI yield 3.7%, 3.3% after depreciation, acquired 2026-09-30 inside the Feb-2027 period and debt-funded. That forecast also leaned on an ¥805m reserve drawdown (about ¥146 a unit), and the asset manager's stated goal is DPU growth of 3% a year plus α. So this print, which must also issue a first Aug-2027 forecast, is more likely to raise the forward DPU path (toward roughly ¥2,480-2,520) than to hold it.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-21 (15:30): acquisitions plus a higher forward guide, then +1.08% next session against +0.80% for the REIT ETF (1343.T). 2026-04-21 (15:30): Feb-26 beat (2,414 vs 2,380) and Aug-26 guide raised 2,400 to 2,450, then -1.69% against -0.82% for the ETF. Raises have been bought weakly or sold.
evidence.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The acquisition and its yield have been public since 2026-08-26, and the company then said no forecast revision, so the market has not been handed a DPU number. If a raise were fully priced, the stock should have held up against the sector. Instead it fell with the REIT ETF (-6.25% vs about -5.8%) and shows no relative strength into the print. The size stays small because this name raises routinely and the raise is the expected outcome.
evidence.independence: The forecast and its reserve-drawdown assumption come from the April 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260421507261.pdf). The habit of raising comes from the Oct-2025 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251021/140120251021576479.pdf: Feb-26 2,380 and Aug-26 2,400, later 2,414 actual and 2,450). All are company documents, so they are one issuer's record, not independent confirmation of the market's expectation.

evidence.text: Aug-2026 (49th period) DPU will likely print slightly above the ¥2,450 forecast. Each of the last two periods came in at or above the forecast set six months earlier (Feb-26: 2,414 actual vs 2,380), and the Hamamatsu Act Tower first-tranche gain (sale ¥17.15bn in total vs ¥14.7bn appraisal) is already inside this period's plan.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: A reported-period beat of about 1.4% (Feb-26) came with -1.69% on 2026-04-22. The reported period has not moved this name on its own.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. A J-REIT's current-period DPU sits inside the guided range, any excess is often sent to the 圧縮積立金 reserve rather than paid out, and holders expect a small beat. It is filed at near zero for that reason.
evidence.independence: The Apr-2026 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260421507261.pdf) shows the Feb-26 actual of 2,414 against the earlier 2,380 forecast. Same issuer.

evidence.text: The Feb-2027 forecast already shows ordinary profit -12.9% period on period, because the Aug-26 sale gain rolls off. kabutan's automated headline for each Aug-FY J-REIT this month has read '今期経常は○%減益へ', and peers split on it: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund (3462) fell 4.58% vs -0.36% for the ETF after its 10-16 release, while GLP (3281, +0.70%) and Mitsui Fudosan Accommodations (3226, +1.01%) rose.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's own April-2026 headline read '今期経常は1%増で3期連続最高益更新へ' and the stock still fell 1.69%. No own instance of a 減益 headline on record.
evidence.why_not_priced: The profit decline is in the April forecast, so it is public. What is not public is how the release frames it. The peer evidence is mixed (one down, two up), so this is a proxy kept near zero.
evidence.independence: Peer releases: GLP https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3281&b=k202610150119 (2026-10-15) and MFA https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3226&b=k202610200003 (2026-10-20). Both went the other way, which is why this is [sizing note removed].
